internal.title: Internal Direct Capture
internal.hint: No sales partner is assigned to customers originating from telephone calls, referrals or offline advertisements. The case remains internal and can be advised and calculated directly.

personal.title: Personal Details
personal.intro: Enter the property owner's personal details.
personal.consentText: The customer consents to their data being processed for the purpose of preparing an offer and being transmitted to WohnKapital.

model.title: Preferred Model
model.intro: First select the preferred main model. Only the relevant fields will then be displayed.
model.locked: The model cannot be changed for portfolio customers.
model.residentialRightDescription: The customer sells the property and retains a contractually agreed right of residence.
model.rentBackSaleDescription: The customer sells the property and remains in it as a tenant/resident.
model.selectHint: Select a model to display the relevant information.
model.rentBackDisclosureText: Under the Sale and Rent-Back model, ongoing rent is payable from day one after the sale. This must be discussed with the customer before submission.
model.rentBackDisclosureShort: Under the Sale and Rent-Back model, ongoing rent is payable from day one after the sale.
model.recipients: Who should receive the right of residence?
model.whichPerson: Which person receives the right of residence?
model.durationHint: A term between 5 and 15 years can be selected.
model.fixedTermReasonPlaceholder: e.g. family plans or health reasons
model.eligibleSoon: The younger person will reach the minimum age of 75 within three months.
model.notEligible: The Lifetime Model is only available from age 75. For two people, the younger person determines eligibility.

property.title: Property Details
property.intro: Enter the key characteristics of the property.
property.impressionHint: Further professional assessments are derived internally from documents, queries and valuation. The customer intake only records the visible impression of the property.
property.certificateHint: Additional fields appear once an Energy Performance Certificate is available.
property.parkingAvailable: Are parking spaces, garages or carports available?
property.majorMaintenance: Are any major maintenance works, refurbishment measures or special assessments known or foreseeable?
property.exclusionHint: If selected, the case cannot be submitted.
property.precheckHint: Review the following knock-out criteria carefully. If any criterion applies, the case may not be processed further or may require an internal review.
property.knownDefectsPlaceholder: e.g. moisture, repairs or refurbishment discussions
property.notesPlaceholder: Internal notes or special considerations for the review

modernisations.title: Modernisations
modernisations.intro: First record completed modernisations. The current condition of the components is recorded separately below.
modernisations.moisture: Is any moisture, mould or water damage known?
modernisations.moistureDescription: Describe the known moisture, mould or water damage

documents.title: Documents
documents.intro: Upload documents directly in the relevant row. Multiple files can be uploaded for each document type.
documents.submitHint: Before submission, we automatically check whether all required information and documents are available.
documents.powerHint: Only required while no current land register extract has been uploaded.
documents.apartmentHint: Apartment-specific documents: the declaration of division, service charge statements, meeting minutes and maintenance reserve evidence must be reviewed for apartments.
documents.existing: Already available in the customer folder.

notes.land_register: Alternatively, upload a land register power of attorney if the extract is not yet available.
notes.photos: Interior, exterior, garden where applicable, every room, basement, heating system and value-relevant features.
notes.service_charge_statement: Required, preferably for the last two years.
notes.owners_meeting_minutes: Required, preferably for the last two years including the resolutions register.
notes.maintenance_reserve: Required if not clearly shown in the service charge statement.
notes.power_of_attorney: Only required if no current land register extract is uploaded.
notes.energy_certificate: Optional. Please upload it where available.
notes.repair_offer: Optional for known defects or planned works.
notes.other: For example site plan, building file, insurance documents, tenancy agreement, encumbrances or special agreements.
